title: Call log retention rule (UK GDPR)
summary: Call logs are now kept for 24 months and then removed automatically, in line with UK GDPR.
changes: Add a daily job that deletes call logs older than 24 months.
The retention period can be changed with the CALL_LOG_RETENTION_MONTHS setting.
Each clean-up is recorded in the audit log with how many logs were removed.
version_rationale: Patch: adds a scheduled clean-up job and one setting; no schema change.
validation: New feature test for the 24-month cut-off, setting and option overrides, and the daily schedule.
Mail log, deployment settings and translation tests.
known_limitations: Removal runs once a day, so a log can be kept up to a day past 24 months.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. Logs already removed cannot be restored except from backups.
provenance: Milestone v0.49.3 Beta, issue #480 under epic #475, pull request #618.
